# `to_date`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Parses the `date_str` expression with the `fmt` expression to
a date. Returns null with invalid input. By default, it follows casting rules to a date if
the `fmt` is omitted.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
to_date(date_str[, fmt])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [1, 2] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- to_date, example 1
> SELECT to_date('2009-07-30 04:17:52');
2009-07-30
```

```sql
-- to_date, example 2
> SELECT to_date('2016-12-31', 'yyyy-MM-dd');
2016-12-31
```
